‘Real Housewives’ Cast Members to Star in Off-Broadway Revival of Neil Simon’s ‘Rumors’

29 Oct 2026, 11:27 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Entertainment Desk · Source: variety.com

Key takeawaysAn upcoming Off-Broadway revival of Neil Simon’s farce "Rumors" will feature a star-studded cast of personalities from the "Real Housewives" franchise. The limited engagement is scheduled to run at the Newman Mills Theater at the Robert W. Wilson MCC Theater Space, with

An upcoming Off-Broadway revival of Neil Simon’s farce "Rumors" will feature a star-studded cast of personalities from the "Real Housewives" franchise. The limited engagement is scheduled to run at the Newman Mills Theater at the Robert W. Wilson MCC Theater Space, with performances beginning on January 9 and an official opening night set for January 25, 2027.

Written by acclaimed playwright Neil Simon, "Rumors" originally opened on Broadway in November 1988 under the direction of Gene Saks, with a cast that included Christine Baranski, Jessica Walter, Joyce Van Patten, and Lisa Banes. The plot follows four couples arriving at a high-end dinner party in a wealthy New York suburb, only to discover their host incapacitated, his wife missing, and law enforcement approaching.

Cast Lineup and Split Engagement

The upcoming production will utilize two separate casts across its run. The first group of Bravo stars will perform from January 9 through February 28, featuring Lisa Rinna as Chris, Phaedra Parks as Claire, Stacey Rusch as Cookie, and Dolores Catania as Cassie.

A second cast will take over the roles from March 2 through April 21, featuring Cynthia Bailey as Chris, Eileen Davidson as Claire, Carole Radziwill as Cookie, and Candiace Dillard-Bassett as Cassie. Casting details for the male roles, representing the husbands in the play, have not yet been announced.

Except for Lisa Rinna—who has previous Broadway experience including roles in "Chicago" and an upcoming revival of "It’s a Wonderful Life"—the production marks the New York stage debut for the rest of the announced cast members.

Behind the Production

Tony Award winner Zhailon Levingston, recognized for his work on "Cats: The Jellicle Ball," is slated to direct the revival. In a statement regarding the production, Levingston noted that the staging aims to explore Simon's text without altering the script, using the presence of the reality television stars to reflect on how private lives translate into public spectacles.

"Without changing a single word of Simon’s brilliant text, we can reveal something new in the piece: The delicious chaos that unfolds when private lives become public spectacle," Levingston said.

Practical Implications and What Readers Can Verify

For theatergoers and fans interested in attending the limited engagement, tickets and future updates can be monitored through official announcements.

  • Confirmed Details: The production runs from January 9 to April 21, 2027, at the Newman Mills Theater at the Robert W. Wilson MCC Theater Space, directed by Zhailon Levingston. It features two distinct casts of "Real Housewives" alumni performing across separate blocks of dates.
  • Uncertain Facts: The identities of the actors who will portray the husbands remain unannounced, and specific ticketing release dates or box office instructions were not detailed in the initial announcement.
  • Verification: Readers can verify the original reporting and check for future casting updates directly through [Variety](https://variety.com/2026/legit/news/real-housewives-lisa-rinna-phaedra-parks-dolores-catania-neil-simon-rumors-revival-1236932105/).
